info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card E-Commerce Gateway API
info.description: The Card E-Commerce Gateway API facilitates the patching of payment details for card transactions in an e-commerce context. This endpoint allows merchants to update specific attributes related to card payments, thereby enhancing transaction processing capabilities. Typical consumers of this API include online retailers and payment processors seeking to maintain accurate transaction data and improve payment workflows. Use cases include adjusting payment status, modifying transaction parameters, and managing discrepancies in card payment information.

patch.summary: Update payment details for a specific card transaction.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details associated with a specific card transaction identified by CARD-400045 in the card e-commerce gateway. Use this to modify transaction attributes as necessary.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the status or details of a card payment transaction in the card e-commerce gateway. Make sure to include all necessary fields as defined in the schema to ensure a successful processing of the request.
